defects.title: User feedback is missing from live predictions
defects.evidence: 5 of 5 logged predictions contain no user feedback.
defects.likely_cause: The prediction API currently logs predictions but does not yet collect explicit user relevance feedback.
defects.business_impact: The team cannot reliably measure whether recommendations are useful to users after launch.
defects.recommended_action: Add recommendation feedback events such as relevant, not relevant, clicked, applied and dismissed.

defects.title: Production relevance labels are unavailable
defects.evidence: Current evaluation uses benchmark expected scores rather than genuine post-launch user relevance labels.
defects.likely_cause: The system has prediction logging but does not yet maintain a labelled feedback dataset for online evaluation.
defects.business_impact: Offline-online agreement cannot yet be interpreted as real user recommendation accuracy.
defects.recommended_action: Build a feedback-labelled evaluation dataset and calculate precision, recall, ranking quality or other agreed relevance metrics on real interactions.

defects.title: Low-score recommendation requires review
defects.evidence: 2 of 5 predictions have a match score below 50.
defects.likely_cause: Low overlap between student skills and required job skills.
defects.business_impact: Low-quality matches may reduce recommendation usefulness if they are surfaced too prominently.
defects.recommended_action: Review ranking thresholds and consider filtering or explaining low-confidence recommendations.

defects.title: Live evaluation sample is too small
defects.evidence: Only 5 live predictions are currently available for analysis.
defects.likely_cause: The post-launch monitoring pipeline has only recently been activated.
defects.business_impact: Small samples can make model-health metrics unstable and may hide rare failure patterns.
defects.recommended_action: Continue collecting production-safe interaction logs and define minimum sample thresholds before automated health decisions.
